traps.detail: Temporary and final certificates are both listed; one building can have several. Filter issue_type or count each job once.
pr_dwelling_unit is the building's total, not the units added; subtract ex_dwelling_unit for net new homes.
Coordinates are geocoded to the street frontage, so many points sit just outside their lot. Match lots with polygon_match = nearest (about 30 m), or by BBL.
Condominium buildings carry billing BBLs (lot 75xx) that are not tax lots in MapPLUTO; match those by location.

Certificates come years after construction starts: buildings already standing or under way at the prediction date get certificates afterwards. Exclude them (e.g. by year built) or use permits for new starts.
Only outcomes from 2021-01-01 on, after the prediction date 2021-01-01.
1,742 records fell outside every prediction feature.
Only 30 of 1,772 records fall inside a prediction polygon, but 601 lie within 30 m of one. They are probably geocoded to a street frontage; rerun with polygon_match = nearest.
